mechanics.claim: The projectile deals full damage to the first enemy hit, then expands and deals only 60% damage to enemies hit thereafter.
mechanics.quote: fires a piercing shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy it passes through, after which it expands in width but deals only 60% damage to enemies it hits thereafter

mechanics.claim: Dealing damage with this ability resets Caitlyn's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Upon ''Piltover Peacemaker'' dealing damage to an enemy, '''Caitlyn's''' [[attack timer]] is forcibly {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}}.

mechanics.claim: Enemies revealed by Yordle Snap Trap always take full (non-reduced) damage from this ability regardless of hit order.
mechanics.quote: Enemies {{tip|true sight|revealed}} by ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' always take {{ccs|full damage|physical}} from ''Piltover Peacemaker''.

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit while protected by a spell shield still count as a target for the damage calculation of subsequent hits (i.e. still trigger the reduced-damage expansion).
mechanics.quote: Enemies hit while protected by a {{tip|spell shield}} will still be considered a target for calculating damage for subsequent hits.
